tools.name: task
tools.description: Maintain the session task plan. Omit action when title, id, or filters make the intent clear; tasks start as todo unless status is in-progress.

action.description: Optional when the supplied fields make the action clear.

title.description: Task title for add or update.

status.description: Task state; all is a list filter only.

priority.description: Optional task priority or list filter. Defaults to normal when adding.

tags.description: Task tags. An empty array clears tags on update.

documents.description: Planning-document paths. An empty array clears links on update.

limit.description: Optional list limit; defaults to the session policy.
